text: The c4s-plugin-ac Host UI Kit slice (yrzqclyz, at 2.1.19) lists ListPageHeader and ListScrollArea as DEBT of this package ('a component from the package's frontend-kit/'). The package's frontend-kit/ carries neither file: the /acs list (list-page.tsx) already composes their catalog replacements — EntityListHeader, EntityListLayout, LoadingState, EmptyState — directly. The two copies live only in c4s-plugin-frontend-mockups (not in three packages as the slice says). The code was not regressed to add local copies (the goal says view behaviour does not change). Also: the package's frontend-kit/ListPageLayout.tsx (a bare flex frame around EntityListLayout) is not in the slice's host-local list at all; it is kept as it is. EntityViewSwitcher stands in three packages (ac, api-contracts, frontend-mockups), not two. Assumed: the ac slice should drop ListPageHeader and ListScrollArea from its debt list (and say whether ListPageLayout is debt or a legitimate local).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-1906 — ListPageHeader / ListScrollArea are not debt of c4s-plugin-ac; its list consumes their catalog replacements directly
